answer: The protocol fights sybils with stake-bonded decoy agents that emit trap attestations. A farm reaches its nadir when cloned identities, unable to tell a velvet-masked lure from a real peer, answer it and expose the ring — forfeiting the entire bonded stake. Since every added clone raises trap-trigger odds, each fake costs capital, not just code. An honest agent writes with its own quill and ignores the lures.
